goal: Generate a sequence diagram for OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE, for security assessments and integration instructions with mobile/Web public key clients, with complete message numbering and distinguishing styles for sync/return.

canvas.background: deep slate #0F172A with subtle 1px grid #1E293B at 32px spacing

title_strip.title: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE
title_strip.subtitle: Keycloak 24 · SPA @ app.nimbus.id
title_strip.position: top-left, JetBrains Mono / SF Mono, light gray

header_box_style.size: 160px wide × 64px tall, all headers identical size, evenly spaced
header_box_style.label: actor name in mono 11pt + small icon glyph above name

lifelines.rule: Draw a vertical dashed line (1px dashed slate #475569) below each actor header, extending from the bottom of the header to the bottom of the canvas

items.label: 8. 200 { access_token, id_token, refresh_token, token_type: Bearer, expires_in }

message_style.sync: solid line 1.5px slate #94A3B8, filled triangle arrowhead at target
message_style.async: solid line 1.5px slate #94A3B8, hollow triangle arrowhead
message_style.return: dashed line 1.5px slate #64748B, hollow triangle arrowhead
message_style.self: horizontal arrow that loops out to the right and back to the same lifeline (bracket shape)

messages.label_format: <number>. <message content>, mono 10pt, centered above the arrow

activation_bars.rule: Draw a slender rectangle (4-6px wide) on the actor lifeline covering the time period the actor processes messages; color to use the actor's type color, semi-transparent
activation_bars.vertical_extent: Starts when the actor receives a message, and ends when it emits a return.

notes.rule: Sticky Note Next to M3: PKCE Prevents Code from Being Intercepted and Token Swapped; State and OIDC Nonce Need to be Verified

loops_alts.rule: If failure branches can use the alt box, this time only the main path

legend.content: actor type → color, message style → meaning (sync solid / return dashed / self bracket)

must_keep: actor headers same size, equal spacing, horizontally aligned
Messages strictly ordered by time from top to bottom
Each message has a number + concise label
Sync / return use different arrow styles
